payload.title: Strict contract-selected WP02 closure, then physical Andreas BASE14
payload.work_clay: LATEST REVISION WINS. Pull newest main before every effect. The authoritative WP02 declarative grammar is no longer hardcoded in workers: read research_entity/claycode/base/ANDREAS_UBUNTU_TARGET_RECEIPT_CONTRACT.json. It currently selects D_LALR_GRAMMAR_REPAIR_CANDIDATE_V17_DECLARATIVE_TRIVIA_SAFE.lark because V9/V10 made horizontal trivia semantically active for Needle.owns(X) versus Needle.owns (X). V17 is the minimal V9 declarative repair and must not import V7/V10/V15/V16 typed-fn/operator expansion merely for unification. On a verified local Ubuntu executor with lark+interegular run exactly: python3 tools/claycode_wp02_strict_local_closure_v2.py. Require research_entity/claycode/base/receipts/LOCAL_WP02_SELECTED_GRAMMAR_CLOSURE.json pass=true. For V17 this aggregate must include a strict V17 selection discriminator, strict LALR construction, exact G9 V3 + Dialect V3 full-corpus frontend, canonical trivia identity, grammar-bound declarative IR for both corpora and the production canonicalizer default, all bound to the exact contract-selected grammar SHA. GitHub-hosted Actions previously failed before Step 1 and remains negative infrastructure evidence unless a later run actually executes steps; never treat that pre-step failure as language evidence. After local selected-WP02 strict closure, on the owner-registered physical Andreas Ubuntu host run bash tools/claycode_bootstrap_andreas_self_hosted_runner.sh and python3 tools/claycode_run_andreas_target_acceptance.py. The physical autoprobe now retriggers on the acceptance contract, every grammar candidate and the V17 discriminator; target collector and strict assembler independently read the same central WP02 contract. Preserve negative receipts. Never weaken host identity, clean checkout, non-container, real mapped desktop, authority, APP01-10, five-path FULL_FRANK, P0/P1 or WP14 gates. frank_runtime.clay remains CONTEXT_ONLY_NON_GATE unless explicitly selected as a production executable.
payload.reason_clay: A concrete V9/V10 parser counterexample was found after the earlier V9 closure plan: whitespace before '(' could turn qualified Needle.owns call syntax into the higher-priority dotted-prefix token. V17 isolates only the trivia-safe lookahead repair. Production frontend, strict frontend validator, canonicalizer and canonicalizer validator now enforce the repaired invariant. The Andreas target acceptance contract centrally selects V17; collector, strict assembler, hosted CI and physical autoprobe derive or react to that contract instead of maintaining independent V9 hardcodes. This removes both the semantic-trivia bug and the parser-version drift class without claiming an unexecuted PASS.
payload.completion_clay: Complete only when (1) LOCAL_WP02_SELECTED_GRAMMAR_CLOSURE pass=true for the contract-selected grammar with strict interegular evidence, including Needle.owns(X) == Needle.owns (X); (2) the registered physical Andreas Ubuntu target emits the selected-grammar strict receipt, scoped self-hosted autoprobe, BASE14 closure and strict acceptance; (3) all ten real applications including mapped GUI pass; (4) five-path FULL_FRANK production handoff passes with zero semantic escape hatches; (5) WP14 independently passes; (6) open P0/P1 remains zero; and (7) CLAYCODE_GENERAL_PURPOSE_COMPILER_MANIFEST and CLAYCODE_RELEASE_WORKSPACE are promoted by receipts to PASS. No proxy, sandbox, hosted pre-step failure or model statement can substitute for these receipts.
payload.executor_policy: Verified local Ubuntu executor for selected-WP02 strict parser/canonical evidence; owner-registered physical Andreas Ubuntu host for target/application/FULL_FRANK/WP14 evidence; contract-selected grammar is the sole WP02 parser authority; always re-read latest main; preserve negative results; model output != execution authority.
